assets.name: rail
assets.prompt: A historically credible green European steam locomotive of about 1840, three-quarter side view, long slim horizontal green boiler, tall narrow straight chimney, one pair of large spoked driving wheels between two pairs of smaller spoked wheels, exposed brass pipes and simple iron frame, open footplate behind the boiler with visible backhead, compact separate coal tender. Early railway engineering proportions, elegant and lightly built, complete locomotive with every wheel visible. Flat pure magenta (#FF00FF) background. No enclosed cab, no modern cowcatcher, no people, no text or numbers.
assets.review: cold review: open 1840s footplate and tall chimney; finished WebP checked on parchment
